description: Generate a PDF document from a template and data. Returns a download URL for the generated PDF. Provide either `template_id` (to use a saved template) or `markup` (inline HTML/Handlebars template). The `data` object is injected into the template to produce the final document. Supports custom paper sizes, orientation, and filenames.

data.description: Key-value data to populate the template placeholders.

filename.description: Custom filename for the generated PDF (e.g. 'invoice-2024.pdf').

markup.description: Inline HTML/Handlebars markup template. Use when you don't have a saved template.

paper_size.description: Paper size for the PDF. Defaults to A4.

template_id.description: ID of a saved template to use. Mutually exclusive with markup.

name: generate_document
